name: Vasa Denticity Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2016, Vasa Denticity Limited is in the business of marketing and distribution 
 of a comprehensive portfolio of Dental Products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1][2]
Vasa Denticity is a Dental Products e-commerce company with 20,000+ SKUs, 30 owned Brands, and 300+ Domestic and international Brand tie-ups. It specializes in Orthodontics, Endodontics, Oral Surgery, diagnosis, treatment, and aesthetics.[3]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 186% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 25.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.37%
Working capital days have increased from 91.4 days to 154 days
